「纯阳之体」是极为罕见的易热体质，有此体质者，周身阳气流转，稍不注意便会陷入热血冲头的状态。重云深受其害，发作时阳气暴行周身，性情大变，对自身作为一概不知。然而，这一体质也是他走天下的最大资本，每到阴寒之地，原地一坐，就能将妖邪驱逐殆尽。

由此，重云的驱邪路顺畅无比。可惜他本人并不认可这种做法，在作风端正老实的他心中，光凭体质行驱邪之事不过是耍小聪明。若是真正的方士，自当以方术见长。

为与「纯阳之体」抗衡，重云日常起居遵循以下原则：不见烈阳、不喝热水，不吃热食，不沾辛辣，不衣厚裳，不争执，不起怒。他周游各地，试遍天下偏方，仍未能将体内正阳压制分毫。

年轻的方士不由苦恼起来：妖是除了，可长此以往，他要怎么做才能证明自己是一个合格的方士呢？

坐在雪山吃雪馒头的重云思及此时，不由得叹道：往后的路，还长着哪。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":false}

{"rich_text":"

璃月港悠长的历史中，各种妖邪异闻从未断绝。无论真相如何，总要有人出面解决。

重云出生于知名驱邪世家，自幼便拥有能够慑退鬼怪的「纯阳之体」。他的驱邪之法异于常人，只需在异闻之地静坐一番，妖邪当即四散。

但这对重云来说，是个很大的困扰——单论驱邪之事，他已身经百战。可迄今为止，他连半张妖邪的正脸都没见过。

重云心中自知：依赖「纯阳之体」终归是取巧，咒法与剑术才是正道。

因此，他苦心研习方术与武技，四处寻访传闻中妖邪出没之地，以证明白己驱邪的本事与特殊体质无关。

但…这体质究竟要到什么时候，才能不妨碍重云的自我证明之路呢？

{"list":[{"tab_name":"汉语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我名重云，家族久居璃月，世代以驱邪除魔为业。今日萍水相逢，看来我与阁下有些缘分。唔…不收钱的，不收钱！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f627acce6fb7022453f29eaa431de52e_804024992164447343.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·驱邪之法","content":"方士驱邪一靠咒术，二赖武艺。另辟蹊径亦可，但终非正道。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8bc59c5bc5727b47c9821fcb08d2cc16_2374330755777304309.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·饮食","content":"寒食饮冰利于平神静气…清心泡水辅以冰块饮下，对身体最好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bb67fa4db9991465ab7a75f50743cc16_6777820293351008858.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·口诀","content":"驱邪缚魅，内外澄清，啊，呃…糟了，后半句口诀忘了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/031b2304573bfa44eca74defa47eb490_3116186378063717539.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"雨是无根水，是最澄净的水，对驱邪除魔大有帮助。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f28f8ac78258c854bdef90d0b5f17625_7740022616250079408.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"这落雷好大阵仗，妖邪也会惧怕的吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eeac92c59b172315e64416581b29d806_4733782485027762251.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"啊…好天气，真是舒服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/88442073ab1d6e7f1acae09f08529ce5_7518920159684896675.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早晨的好时光可不能辜负，抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ef655f1547486055ef7ee31c9ba7d6ee_6555016746921328617.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"正午灵气极盛，可得抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a247d91033c21fe8f104ae75c707dd6d_4350463249399709085.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"晚间最适静息凝神，更要抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8a670c462d3ec7e033feeee64ee4c111_1458103958960533732.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"呼，累了一整天，你也休息去吧。明天再去传闻中鬼怪出没的老宅看看，说好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6066b9da897a157d2b67ea01d649466f_241449809279028214.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云自己·方士","content":"我们方士一派自古守护璃月，传承久远，剿杀邪魔自然是手到擒来。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9d65e07e90bf07e35b781d507d958d6b_1961147467179509724.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云自己·委托","content":"明明什么都没做，只是进了凶宅的门就解决了问题。这个委托的报酬，你觉得是拿还是不拿呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/290c235308c8dd03555f37be4cf6a788_8581798265173256376.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·旅伴","content":"你的本事不错，对丘丘…咳…邪魔从不手软，我们结伴而行如何。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/affa85f3dc26d48bd883eee9b9b594b0_8417053599165625633.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·怪谈","content":"璃月的奇闻异事你已经见了不少吧，你说的那些方外的鬼怪，我…我也想看看。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d9b03a2db54a967d93f0947e7dc1d26c_2420138997661552057.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"「神之眼」虽然厉害，却不可盲目依赖。我还是更加信任方术和武技。本事要精进，还是得勤学苦练。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e314f984b64ac6c869678fd137787a99_7202176674555826673.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"璃月的土地上妖邪传闻虽然众多，但真假掺杂，有些奇奇怪怪的委托…其实跟鬼怪一点关系也没有。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8cdd8097ba68c4dcc91d4cc64f56c7a7_6538081817705298463.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"听说琥牢山的琥珀中封存了不少稀奇古怪的东西，会不会也有一些历史传说中的妖邪呢？真想见识见识。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fc6a85c157259383ffb96c3a085bc43a_2731208277042061091.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"「往生堂」的钟离先生啊，隐约觉得是个厉害角色，凡夫恶党杀人，我们方士除妖，他居然能葬仙人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9bab04050aa859278c652273fc707b23_2457370489004994688.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"我虽然敬佩行秋的武艺和侠心。但是我一定要事先提醒你，他坏心思也不少。如果真的发生了什么事情，记得回来和我结成受害者同盟啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3e2b2453d1b20b3931193a3565e203fe_7058698710601709871.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"降魔大圣和我们方士一派，一暗一明，共守璃月，历史已久，我非常尊敬魈上仙。但是，那位大人居然说…居然说什么驱邪方士量小力微不值一提，我，我绝对不能苟同！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6a43d7c3a25fd2a5c9b62d763741c61f_1683126319424222007.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"「往生堂」的手段还是信得过的。但是那副「不用你们方士操心」的嘻嘻笑脸却看着让人火大…呼，冷静冷静。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e0aa0f69ada5c4e0f23e703e0341b0e9_3043612130284419119.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于七七…","content":"看起来是个僵尸小姑娘，但作为方士我能察觉到…她可不一般。嗯…名字也不见宝诰之中，究竟是哪尊呢…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/33b49d987da9015a6b2c2ba5ab6022ea_8600029835944980664.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"我会尽可能避开辛焱演出的区域。那般热烈的气氛，即使无意融入，也难免受其影响…我是说，会让人不自在。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2af9044a435fab15d102a097f11ededb_8314445962263666195.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱…","content":"香菱做菜的手艺有口皆碑，但是她那些辛辣烫口的菜品我是绝对不会碰的…没有，没有什么…你看，史莱姆滑蘑菇？这能吃吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/13ae3257849ed18d22a560d3acefd814_8236844554379059855.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"我曾听家中长辈聊起过她。她家的遭遇…很让人同情。原以为这次能够让分家的远亲重回家中，长辈们听说她还活着也都高兴坏了，说是要备上礼物，择个吉日好好聚聚。却没想到，平日根本见不到她的人影…等等，按辈分来算的话，我、我该不会…要叫她「小姨」吧…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/48921d2e7242cba981f6c1d2f9df5604_6977748978898821599.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于夜兰…","content":"我初任方士那会儿，受邀到委托人家中驱邪，离开时，曾撞见过这位女性。她把我的名字记在某个小册子里，或许是想确认我有没有做值得怀疑的事吧。不过就那一次，后来再没遇见过她。

现在想想，大概是因为我平日打坐总是一动不动，谁看着都会觉得无趣吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/69ac59572b5851d704190aebe4e4c124_4038219655286567915.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其一","content":"本事很重要，不然空有热血，只会坏事。对于这点，我深有体会。啊，倒不是我自己的体会，呃…是近年行走璃月，观看人间百态的感悟。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/648d98ff57bca7804802af311c7ff102_1448083119051694985.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其二","content":"我天生是「纯阳之体」，据说千年难遇，所有鬼怪对我退避三舍。唉…这其实一点都不好，哪有见不着鬼怪的驱邪方士。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/faaf6410de475262bf8bc3f6d80d51fb_6401100662660351386.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其三","content":"「纯阳之体」常常导致热血太盛，没少害我出糗。我不食辛辣高温、出门撑伞、回避激荡的音律，就是为了克制它。唉…什么时候这体质才能不妨碍我呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f5ea679904bdef6fb2a89c4ea53054c5_223061551757900824.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其四","content":"坐等妖邪现身是没用的，得主动寻访。我为璃月人镇邪，于人能免去烦愁，于我也能广开视野。如果你遇到邪祟搅扰，我一定也会立刻来帮你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0773aed3c00d1e715160fa60f02d583e_3927391022922750022.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其五","content":"剿灭天下妖邪是我身为方士的最终目标，将来这个宏愿实现之后，不管是温泉、绝云椒椒还是别的什么…热血刺激的东西，我其实…都可以考虑。唔…不行。这样想想就会有些激动…不好不好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1e12b6448671cbf4dc508178ed47dd5d_1893449255088129769.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重云的爱好…","content":"我？嗯…我最喜欢的还是听说书。茶博士总是能把各种奇闻怪谈讲得惊心动魄。有空不妨一道去听听。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e0e411c9637d134fbc7c1c68bda00e92_5217554207438529351.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重云的烦恼…","content":"经我多方打听，费了好大功夫，才找到一处破庙有妖邪出没！于是，我守了四天，却完全不见妖邪的影子。唉…这种事经常发生。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/95acb2201ab493da97038aa86a268dae_4794163486753336217.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"每日修行完毕后，要是能吃上稻妻运来的生鲜还有冷餐就好了，那种冰凉清爽的口感能缓解所有疲劳。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/beb186ad98e6b7a1262894f626c7d115_6192550590903923191.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"所有又烫又辣的食物我都不能入口。如果是有绝云椒椒的菜，啊，想想就吓人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/49d5f729db9cd2409e35f7ef3da84157_3095006097024181182.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"口感凉爽，正合我意！我要多留一些，等到修行完毕后再来享用。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/2c2feac6d80042b9b7968ffc3061f7ed_5543726931046246868.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"不好意思啊。明明是你的一片心意，我却只能放凉再吃…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/829eaca31f39a9dffcbc3ff2d5fcf2a5_6998798853280298461.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"糟糕！这味道是…绝云椒椒？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/a38b00214c63a7035e33b2c7c1a54eec_8777390535454384891.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"今天是你的生辰，这朵冰晶结成的小花送你，是我自己雕的。如果遇到妖邪，掷出冰花，我封入的咒术自会生效，助你脱险。啊…还有，生日快乐。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/12db8773028efbdf4eadf61e64e5a8dc_8377810504805219943.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"驱邪的术法也常常用到这些材料，没想到还能用于提升自己的灵气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/66e0cab75980ef5d52622d9afb7ed111_3648577771910958872.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"习武与术法一样，都有境界。受你指导，我又有进益了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e83ab4391e0973b47ca9ba96ba1022d1_5393176647598248568.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"原来习武之道还有这样一种境界，手眼相通，人与剑合…嗯，我悟到了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/06/11/183046623/637d7685e3be7b2acfda99cbe6e4c971_3288742957162870513.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"领悟了这些武技，「剿灭天下妖邪」的愿望或许就能达成了。你一路相助，我当然铭感在心，今后赴汤蹈火在所不辞。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7ef4eaf7c9a8e3ad7ee81c993762c8c4_5820654380021870402.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"剑印染冰！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a072ece39e3862337fe88018f37c9c8d_4962529030393175584.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"剑，出！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ce342f5eaaef27be89dff9cbcee48832_6509995927071943874.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"急如敕令。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c8f82803f85262598dea2da9f673c43a_8773904086080255294.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"听我法旨。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9f7c9a872418e7d25af506f7614124ac_2584977775061951257.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"邪魔退去！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5df85214933894611d97205b8a6fcadb_157524913419637960.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"宝印幻剑！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fd4715ea85a96d4524b08cf886af8059_4294123945929642240.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"束手伏诛吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6ebadef980bab7df729f5a84646f3b36_4535498674086655168.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开风之翼·其一","content":"且看踏风纵云的本领。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9cf370441caaf9062088d0accec6e621_7677386669540659918.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"这等器物，有助于驱邪除魔。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6a54cc76fb47b2f3b57370938314b489_6101773482459501616.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"不枉你我一番劳苦！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cc4a9cfac3954dc26d2ce3f28ef81163_854912545255710382.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"意外之喜。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fd73189dc968b7efe53a71a695d9a4c2_3527750031580901850.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"小伤不足挂齿。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d539123cea91f5de27afc2a1c5d7fd20_6723732064854013720.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"不能再轻敌了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0557571b4f6ce19785299c47be5c8405_2780461589779570041.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"你莫猖狂！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c1784914729f4dcfd2a836d8c303679c_5684444943146929383.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"我来助你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/44a4f24bf68c32fb974dd74f206e47e3_2552206057170432124.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"务必撑住！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/6c12545f9bcb41938ce25a2f82261303_8981138588575107108.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"还是技不如人吗…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/007445f6189c5e090228f56524eb8df0_6283307779007208144.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"妖邪…未除…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9ad460f1086de061834d5ca772316999_8352054431463540671.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"辱没了…方士一门…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/17745b87614a10776fd664c487e0730c_3629946507415051853.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"居然！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3abea572f7c4e30cd57ae33cfef546c3_6566810686782809651.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"得令。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ea3febd307b8076f43ac281cdde189c4_2895765698545349268.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"我有咒毒杀鬼方。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1a9ee67bea04c12c8490ea7cb37d3003_7940899433629088540.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"是去练功么？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/afe5c5502245df21297f2f41570e318d_811969433145921572.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1701369932742_0"},{"tab_name":"日语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我名重云，家族久居璃月，世代以驱邪除魔为业。今日萍水相逢，看来我与阁下有些缘分。唔…不收钱的，不收钱！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/775a91167dd6dce6a2b842d5075e90c0_2603695765256372187.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·驱邪之法","content":"方士驱邪一靠咒术，二赖武艺。另辟蹊径亦可，但终非正道。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/19585b6b1b0fea369ec0c7089dba227a_6367505756822369480.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·饮食","content":"寒食饮冰利于平神静气…清心泡水辅以冰块饮下，对身体最好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7002f471e0ad622541d78073c1e9daf7_3949226141242165522.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·口诀","content":"驱邪缚魅，内外澄清，啊，呃…糟了，后半句口诀忘了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4c1979a278f46107889880c6dbcd6d96_3781247462180549970.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"雨是无根水，是最澄净的水，对驱邪除魔大有帮助。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b9ad4ae1610bbbfd88120ee98578ba6c_467436603047620365.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"这落雷好大阵仗，妖邪也会惧怕的吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9071104b194bc8bea470995dd04879d7_2325350783083387490.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"啊…好天气，真是舒服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/443a0911e3b0687c8550630a30d44b46_7307073970018074033.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早晨的好时光可不能辜负，抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/36f25d2407c8a7695121e8a2f31efa11_2278788702752488436.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"正午灵气极盛，可得抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9aab808f2cd713affbad24e807ac0870_143626609396673243.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"晚间最适静息凝神，更要抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/64afc62d1cda2c04788ffd989b2d3554_6849173515833555068.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"呼，累了一整天，你也休息去吧。明天再去传闻中鬼怪出没的老宅看看，说好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7bd4fc2dc8710e0d1c154613c41999c8_7791871629336620857.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云自己·方士","content":"我们方士一派自古守护璃月，传承久远，剿杀邪魔自然是手到擒来。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6d4320517d2052da9456ddaf663a692f_8575661262947659742.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云自己·委托","content":"明明什么都没做，只是进了凶宅的门就解决了问题。这个委托的报酬，你觉得是拿还是不拿呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/55462d333c476ac73b02dc7954b74014_2623751991689491377.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·旅伴","content":"你的本事不错，对丘丘…咳…邪魔从不手软，我们结伴而行如何。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/795c7b6a3787043c16673fe6cc9d6740_8936331363364899649.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·怪谈","content":"璃月的奇闻异事你已经见了不少吧，你说的那些方外的鬼怪，我…我也想看看。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fc935ac6f05b68bf99fce9ec54212d69_3136588928875718954.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"「神之眼」虽然厉害，却不可盲目依赖。我还是更加信任方术和武技。本事要精进，还是得勤学苦练。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d97b5b96d1ba347aab48a0537f8248a0_3923957839882456551.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"璃月的土地上妖邪传闻虽然众多，但真假掺杂，有些奇奇怪怪的委托…其实跟鬼怪一点关系也没有。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9e4da3e62fed12fe0d3e12e649eb816e_7929989441987126888.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"听说琥牢山的琥珀中封存了不少稀奇古怪的东西，会不会也有一些历史传说中的妖邪呢？真想见识见识。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/631426e767da555c6f0509a30e771bf5_1466866486705272392.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"「往生堂」的钟离先生啊，隐约觉得是个厉害角色，凡夫恶党杀人，我们方士除妖，他居然能葬仙人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1ff37e30b4ab75e54cc4df053a9034d5_502882502493083741.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"我虽然敬佩行秋的武艺和侠心。但是我一定要事先提醒你，他坏心思也不少。如果真的发生了什么事情，记得回来和我结成受害者同盟啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/193870351aa1dc3c829e4e0867ecf9ce_6609830975942832604.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"降魔大圣和我们方士一派，一暗一明，共守璃月，历史已久，我非常尊敬魈上仙。但是，那位大人居然说…居然说什么驱邪方士量小力微不值一提，我，我绝对不能苟同！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e37291e99d4911ba26342e2a4a061046_5017675861792676130.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"「往生堂」的手段还是信得过的。但是那副「不用你们方士操心」的嘻嘻笑脸却看着让人火大…呼，冷静冷静。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a90029c11b7a0b6f8028d5688f7128be_6130667194388106296.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于七七…","content":"看起来是个僵尸小姑娘，但作为方士我能察觉到…她可不一般。嗯…名字也不见宝诰之中，究竟是哪尊呢…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/50fa5c475ca68dc6cb33dc812549d8c3_5326971480344943202.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"我会尽可能避开辛焱演出的区域。那般热烈的气氛，即使无意融入，也难免受其影响…我是说，会让人不自在。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/182e89240dc6205f7f56331f6706b118_6172447087855173013.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱…","content":"香菱做菜的手艺有口皆碑，但是她那些辛辣烫口的菜品我是绝对不会碰的…没有，没有什么…你看，史莱姆滑蘑菇？这能吃吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4847e7f81c12f42c5e10d5ec8dfa42c5_8018301653365642087.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"我曾听家中长辈聊起过她。她家的遭遇…很让人同情。原以为这次能够让分家的远亲重回家中，长辈们听说她还活着也都高兴坏了，说是要备上礼物，择个吉日好好聚聚。却没想到，平日根本见不到她的人影…等等，按辈分来算的话，我、我该不会…要叫她「小姨」吧…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/265ee4735f611081a4a5db1c6cd23450_5989400200485601299.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于夜兰…","content":"我初任方士那会儿，受邀到委托人家中驱邪，离开时，曾撞见过这位女性。她把我的名字记在某个小册子里，或许是想确认我有没有做值得怀疑的事吧。不过就那一次，后来再没遇见过她。

现在想想，大概是因为我平日打坐总是一动不动，谁看着都会觉得无趣吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ae49231dbbe8029d2589c02fbcc1aa55_3752701409525328282.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其一","content":"本事很重要，不然空有热血，只会坏事。对于这点，我深有体会。啊，倒不是我自己的体会，呃…是近年行走璃月，观看人间百态的感悟。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9812851e15b1a86e1fd306ef4dd4bc81_4754216062303324033.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其二","content":"我天生是「纯阳之体」，据说千年难遇，所有鬼怪对我退避三舍。唉…这其实一点都不好，哪有见不着鬼怪的驱邪方士。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/90923308817aee8ab1a7c8eef9bb2883_3602724091015368239.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其三","content":"「纯阳之体」常常导致热血太盛，没少害我出糗。我不食辛辣高温、出门撑伞、回避激荡的音律，就是为了克制它。唉…什么时候这体质才能不妨碍我呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/840ea489b758014a4ab1c504d77b1d28_6141005446539775293.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其四","content":"坐等妖邪现身是没用的，得主动寻访。我为璃月人镇邪，于人能免去烦愁，于我也能广开视野。如果你遇到邪祟搅扰，我一定也会立刻来帮你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8670a8aa99cf997cd4d2a74f4451a707_4860609359425581384.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其五","content":"剿灭天下妖邪是我身为方士的最终目标，将来这个宏愿实现之后，不管是温泉、绝云椒椒还是别的什么…热血刺激的东西，我其实…都可以考虑。唔…不行。这样想想就会有些激动…不好不好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2f5db51b8e37c2d94cabdcc11691d38b_7583778447126025076.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重云的爱好…","content":"我？嗯…我最喜欢的还是听说书。茶博士总是能把各种奇闻怪谈讲得惊心动魄。有空不妨一道去听听。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4d28f3c4d5500692f103dcb85ed27633_2948281004783917774.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重云的烦恼…","content":"经我多方打听，费了好大功夫，才找到一处破庙有妖邪出没！于是，我守了四天，却完全不见妖邪的影子。唉…这种事经常发生。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7c91b73fab3e7b0ff7b167316a0dd1d0_7999807533474743810.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"每日修行完毕后，要是能吃上稻妻运来的生鲜还有冷餐就好了，那种冰凉清爽的口感能缓解所有疲劳。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/33713094ea0267fef5b07ca0b0980cc4_6059417149994381505.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"所有又烫又辣的食物我都不能入口。如果是有绝云椒椒的菜，啊，想想就吓人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0d99a96695369df09ec7d71438031653_7759254619747898371.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"口感凉爽，正合我意！我要多留一些，等到修行完毕后再来享用。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/c3433dfab13d00d06dd6400843bbbd4b_3201397681362446746.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"不好意思啊。明明是你的一片心意，我却只能放凉再吃…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/4ae6954610a5539092d1aa9cb8925933_6996663960011664514.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"糟糕！这味道是…绝云椒椒？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/8af96d4679225a2870fd4ca56fd6a7b1_2213347947405716960.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"今天是你的生辰，这朵冰晶结成的小花送你，是我自己雕的。如果遇到妖邪，掷出冰花，我封入的咒术自会生效，助你脱险。啊…还有，生日快乐。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/01f2311c03ab032c7f18664aaaad55b3_5115816836694261718.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"驱邪的术法也常常用到这些材料，没想到还能用于提升自己的灵气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cfc7cb38fbb60bd6855f0ea574e49e42_6940323020991586340.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"习武与术法一样，都有境界。受你指导，我又有进益了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6e2c17460120730de0ac8d8059ef7ef4_7504643002031229427.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"原来习武之道还有这样一种境界，手眼相通，人与剑合…嗯，我悟到了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/06/11/183046623/d0802e41748125e1735bea9eab7249e9_8039063694525489384.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"领悟了这些武技，「剿灭天下妖邪」的愿望或许就能达成了。你一路相助，我当然铭感在心，今后赴汤蹈火在所不辞。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/df82388728089f5c18b6f252bfffc3c6_7627441338973025992.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"剑印染冰！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/105affd87a805a8bb2d4a0196885c5c5_1531084788512677036.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"剑，出！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7fe3c0efa903f4e001bfc1e37953ed17_2871884022359974483.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"急如敕令。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3750d4205bfd148a89c26d06eeb68877_5498808300841565188.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"听我法旨。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c01811ec9347fbbc42fa2e20749a07b6_6762953655847281359.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"邪魔退去！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1499d3721b7f68347082a970df69865c_4541812423695932230.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"宝印幻剑！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8fe52aae771d352d21b717e2d3619141_1469717457616293264.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"束手伏诛吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b47391ca1202e6de753555aaf1ee5177_1358344813822788949.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开风之翼·其一","content":"且看踏风纵云的本领。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bf2d6b1e101b34257aa8e8e0dd13ac9e_7733342719533499096.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"这等器物，有助于驱邪除魔。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2402db5e370dd0b700066219cf27a4c2_6837386235807964260.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"不枉你我一番劳苦！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/13525f0604b4b5f9527f689b259d4e74_4122359263503640118.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"意外之喜。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ac55af832e424fb57e2bc1b1decc2894_5285273165049616558.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"小伤不足挂齿。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/61dbe2c7aa0d7df5ee24b35eefef4fa6_5374071365255475149.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"不能再轻敌了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/994af0da3af6d5a03f9fd75a79729604_8093146977373422714.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"你莫猖狂！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ff1e319bbca1140cafb6bd9755675590_5229397409200458025.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"我来助你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/95ddb47af06a48b96147f7665d6529a4_2036930709212131904.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"务必撑住！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/6eb84ba655aae75a12d3a2d0a31789ad_678284332967718262.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"还是技不如人吗…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ca551b7a07d646e3708361fcea6fc33c_5125531595599452963.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"妖邪…未除…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e4b1ad985ad12cbbde050eb359513128_8636489658737231164.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"辱没了…方士一门…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d99df938079bfe2fddd090e78ebd0c76_7378919476113321856.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"居然！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0392b4ed316acc63729140ffbe114586_7357847883856814448.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"得令。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ff2ac06de8ae0d082d9cb857889c78ef_7455026072683972787.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"我有咒毒杀鬼方。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/96b7c38a35086e6941b4714ec3a0b365_5387543030886858939.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"是去练功么？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/46daf7bc67e9611f8fd9c1185ef5ceff_8940309655634077172.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1701369932742_1"},{"tab_name":"韩语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我名重云，家族久居璃月，世代以驱邪除魔为业。今日萍水相逢，看来我与阁下有些缘分。唔…不收钱的，不收钱！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/495b1269d5c9010ef911c73569c15801_8258097757537979003.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·驱邪之法","content":"方士驱邪一靠咒术，二赖武艺。另辟蹊径亦可，但终非正道。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ae34748bfdf11cc22fe7bfae9d3a7332_5292026103180005536.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·饮食","content":"寒食饮冰利于平神静气…清心泡水辅以冰块饮下，对身体最好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/04fd44c1fc04cc462c758b0ea01d7979_1197232161503067956.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·口诀","content":"驱邪缚魅，内外澄清，啊，呃…糟了，后半句口诀忘了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b7c8d3e00692a54f9653f3b2fdadcf75_5780288565980831791.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"雨是无根水，是最澄净的水，对驱邪除魔大有帮助。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6afc0aa302c60ce3040673525ea7df0a_9145970685658321369.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"这落雷好大阵仗，妖邪也会惧怕的吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6b7b30d9add5317c29becf4deda5f29f_5289429604860546054.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"啊…好天气，真是舒服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2a629d939cc6ef426b86e46cdaa20d20_1298317215356200249.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早晨的好时光可不能辜负，抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/39855cebc16622e1a33045693d703f98_8537656021782178968.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"正午灵气极盛，可得抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9d9d6f2ade8821de565452cba0aaa1ee_799321293075676402.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"晚间最适静息凝神，更要抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2a5f5b5543f0447efa69404fafbd21e7_2206267600001500592.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"呼，累了一整天，你也休息去吧。明天再去传闻中鬼怪出没的老宅看看，说好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/51b6695e049007b43ceb041140aba740_2491546134376487178.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云自己·方士","content":"我们方士一派自古守护璃月，传承久远，剿杀邪魔自然是手到擒来。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/50035691d0f8d694cfcf266446e4647f_3302332030643227864.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云自己·委托","content":"明明什么都没做，只是进了凶宅的门就解决了问题。这个委托的报酬，你觉得是拿还是不拿呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9ab24165e738ff50a4a7ff887fd54950_5490953331035678722.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·旅伴","content":"你的本事不错，对丘丘…咳…邪魔从不手软，我们结伴而行如何。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fef13640cfdb692650ad10b6a9d66bc2_3137866779953801357.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·怪谈","content":"璃月的奇闻异事你已经见了不少吧，你说的那些方外的鬼怪，我…我也想看看。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6bd05e808585f5337415f52fbaf08f07_2400447220740914111.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"「神之眼」虽然厉害，却不可盲目依赖。我还是更加信任方术和武技。本事要精进，还是得勤学苦练。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bf16182e6867ecbaa7276a7b7ea6d041_4403078680747607732.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"璃月的土地上妖邪传闻虽然众多，但真假掺杂，有些奇奇怪怪的委托…其实跟鬼怪一点关系也没有。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dc12c8e562846a89d856c86d844657fb_4177604196280369047.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"听说琥牢山的琥珀中封存了不少稀奇古怪的东西，会不会也有一些历史传说中的妖邪呢？真想见识见识。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/03e76deac15924f95ee6334e66ed9fdc_5152989734183169378.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"「往生堂」的钟离先生啊，隐约觉得是个厉害角色，凡夫恶党杀人，我们方士除妖，他居然能葬仙人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b67ac8dd7b94e3c130df90d58252a536_2056868515660439079.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"我虽然敬佩行秋的武艺和侠心。但是我一定要事先提醒你，他坏心思也不少。如果真的发生了什么事情，记得回来和我结成受害者同盟啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8c17a9282defec5b71b0cc41f585c055_6380339959034020857.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"降魔大圣和我们方士一派，一暗一明，共守璃月，历史已久，我非常尊敬魈上仙。但是，那位大人居然说…居然说什么驱邪方士量小力微不值一提，我，我绝对不能苟同！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/309a8334d0dbb61960fc1006a7ee8023_471806887571995593.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"「往生堂」的手段还是信得过的。但是那副「不用你们方士操心」的嘻嘻笑脸却看着让人火大…呼，冷静冷静。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7739a352f57dfa8b1ceb93da021ddcba_4252749944342827178.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于七七…","content":"看起来是个僵尸小姑娘，但作为方士我能察觉到…她可不一般。嗯…名字也不见宝诰之中，究竟是哪尊呢…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b28b071b0e88ee54d0b51b098fc3abe1_8728726959882647261.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"我会尽可能避开辛焱演出的区域。那般热烈的气氛，即使无意融入，也难免受其影响…我是说，会让人不自在。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/61f6e8390991191fc1a600f89232082c_9062627727764142474.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱…","content":"香菱做菜的手艺有口皆碑，但是她那些辛辣烫口的菜品我是绝对不会碰的…没有，没有什么…你看，史莱姆滑蘑菇？这能吃吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ddb6b786a35237f733312980c6b60537_2556190596228315423.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"我曾听家中长辈聊起过她。她家的遭遇…很让人同情。原以为这次能够让分家的远亲重回家中，长辈们听说她还活着也都高兴坏了，说是要备上礼物，择个吉日好好聚聚。却没想到，平日根本见不到她的人影…等等，按辈分来算的话，我、我该不会…要叫她「小姨」吧…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c09a2181ecc78b6527a9761f6a7383e5_3436948148925244483.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于夜兰…","content":"我初任方士那会儿，受邀到委托人家中驱邪，离开时，曾撞见过这位女性。她把我的名字记在某个小册子里，或许是想确认我有没有做值得怀疑的事吧。不过就那一次，后来再没遇见过她。

现在想想，大概是因为我平日打坐总是一动不动，谁看着都会觉得无趣吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0a6b2955cd099412909b2dc501733034_3515712506689621059.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其一","content":"本事很重要，不然空有热血，只会坏事。对于这点，我深有体会。啊，倒不是我自己的体会，呃…是近年行走璃月，观看人间百态的感悟。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/81cf927ffb96edfdd95e905e7aa63f9a_4310059370617793008.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其二","content":"我天生是「纯阳之体」，据说千年难遇，所有鬼怪对我退避三舍。唉…这其实一点都不好，哪有见不着鬼怪的驱邪方士。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/779f882149655644df050fe73d683bc1_1299509868222237616.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其三","content":"「纯阳之体」常常导致热血太盛，没少害我出糗。我不食辛辣高温、出门撑伞、回避激荡的音律，就是为了克制它。唉…什么时候这体质才能不妨碍我呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3413ffcba295cdbcf8d44d496fad91e3_7381430318518267997.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其四","content":"坐等妖邪现身是没用的，得主动寻访。我为璃月人镇邪，于人能免去烦愁，于我也能广开视野。如果你遇到邪祟搅扰，我一定也会立刻来帮你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/490ec28d388dd92bae4bef621ba63885_6040174732228216130.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其五","content":"剿灭天下妖邪是我身为方士的最终目标，将来这个宏愿实现之后，不管是温泉、绝云椒椒还是别的什么…热血刺激的东西，我其实…都可以考虑。唔…不行。这样想想就会有些激动…不好不好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/78ab4d892023206d5866c6fddc6e2df6_1788578526227022999.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重云的爱好…","content":"我？嗯…我最喜欢的还是听说书。茶博士总是能把各种奇闻怪谈讲得惊心动魄。有空不妨一道去听听。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f64bc19ed366f9145d0f188c3cf12573_5400912889360435109.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重云的烦恼…","content":"经我多方打听，费了好大功夫，才找到一处破庙有妖邪出没！于是，我守了四天，却完全不见妖邪的影子。唉…这种事经常发生。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/645a77637293a0d432a21bb049fb1c44_5405037549158197416.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"每日修行完毕后，要是能吃上稻妻运来的生鲜还有冷餐就好了，那种冰凉清爽的口感能缓解所有疲劳。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5a211ed44cffab4dd23be8586c1f4015_2824310720179001972.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"所有又烫又辣的食物我都不能入口。如果是有绝云椒椒的菜，啊，想想就吓人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e43a77f7568af694fcf781d45d2e92e0_4575484217539350029.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"口感凉爽，正合我意！我要多留一些，等到修行完毕后再来享用。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/a39350803f60a28b2ea59a88f3397179_8069948086793869603.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"不好意思啊。明明是你的一片心意，我却只能放凉再吃…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/18acae7f6cc6fb87963c9df04288df52_7938148368618228201.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"糟糕！这味道是…绝云椒椒？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/cb288c069e7a10d22eb76dc11f31f9e9_4706658327042565552.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"今天是你的生辰，这朵冰晶结成的小花送你，是我自己雕的。如果遇到妖邪，掷出冰花，我封入的咒术自会生效，助你脱险。啊…还有，生日快乐。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a6386d74b808767c801c9e5ac41b8d9c_894926213917437450.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"驱邪的术法也常常用到这些材料，没想到还能用于提升自己的灵气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9b5add2a839c1e48fbbb6a7c938a0030_6356748679038804997.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"习武与术法一样，都有境界。受你指导，我又有进益了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c788347e3660dcced8d169366f81d139_8376438282839784987.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"原来习武之道还有这样一种境界，手眼相通，人与剑合…嗯，我悟到了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/06/11/183046623/9abb240a913d0054e5b873929f233a57_2910787253039534859.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"领悟了这些武技，「剿灭天下妖邪」的愿望或许就能达成了。你一路相助，我当然铭感在心，今后赴汤蹈火在所不辞。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e51c77ec58aa972186ff84097b52f071_6100442101316850195.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"剑印染冰！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/722b0b1d707f2bd471f4e76d92b43e21_3687161385796863631.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"剑，出！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b40d49291d8d23a5e0f0b182204676a2_1282217786674045196.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"急如敕令。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/21a84d52f95e4527d5bed8951c2c0e71_4110220346680889514.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"听我法旨。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/11cad70ea03f6ef24c654f6c7e5fb2b4_8290078838181963294.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"邪魔退去！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/75fc615087ec1c5cd132512658b2d51f_4637146126197942531.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"宝印幻剑！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b509ca40906d3525c5bfdd4abf883b1f_5403774657263198830.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"束手伏诛吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/77eb2490f9a73dfd89a38d0a6aa24d43_5543382578932238500.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开风之翼·其一","content":"且看踏风纵云的本领。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/90819cb336d5be011325b52314c54421_2767351179913792501.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"这等器物，有助于驱邪除魔。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b664e8a652c4dbe1bb6553e2bec95822_1006450165518382366.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"不枉你我一番劳苦！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eb093670c6dc3e84a608f20b381b3ff4_7748773466423757654.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"意外之喜。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/58ad82c67bd398ff6ecd60919c6b604a_4328298293142223805.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"小伤不足挂齿。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7239f53aa5209fb832f443531f9ea552_8935756552993143084.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"不能再轻敌了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ee3d60fa32b9756b85a854981e70a96d_5179643193442732905.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"你莫猖狂！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6c2fdf6a0e746bf56ff438b022d73cdb_5392433693929689354.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"我来助你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/fb9d86966396d227e6b44d907d8cdd03_2285335873486479767.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"务必撑住！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/b587c93a647eeb21d761f93c6d861cb3_6170991783160396509.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"还是技不如人吗…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/23b4cd554d883dc22f09316546181002_921090469307840639.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"妖邪…未除…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4c3b4cd6cd93d4e84cf06d47fd63a93c_8124978218393397018.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"辱没了…方士一门…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7d7036720740d7d981a82b6f60222a6a_4925033154725594102.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"居然！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bebaa336a1101bcbe3803d15a1ca240f_7245094318704039488.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"得令。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bb87a473f9995a9835598edb96e7f04b_1500045816276228553.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"我有咒毒杀鬼方。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/df9eb147ca9da3d2cc4f1c3f16acc52e_5810672128511167172.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"是去练功么？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/faf17f93f838125e17ceb64c9da508db_2163048512315273246.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1701369932742_2"},{"tab_name":"英语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我名重云，家族久居璃月，世代以驱邪除魔为业。今日萍水相逢，看来我与阁下有些缘分。唔…不收钱的，不收钱！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f508828ea34ef9c1c164e8d22ee5abd8_5830033642388918220.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·驱邪之法","content":"方士驱邪一靠咒术，二赖武艺。另辟蹊径亦可，但终非正道。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4ccd39863deea69c56a972e7c2f60aa6_6089001017259719158.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·饮食","content":"寒食饮冰利于平神静气…清心泡水辅以冰块饮下，对身体最好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6d400daf89723735b4fb0fe96dfd1d7a_7357807481295345103.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·口诀","content":"驱邪缚魅，内外澄清，啊，呃…糟了，后半句口诀忘了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/86b14200fb2da211b77778a7a5c98727_3418033389066578068.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"雨是无根水，是最澄净的水，对驱邪除魔大有帮助。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6bca25f59ea6629938e07c54de5a2c19_4819269167772026234.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"这落雷好大阵仗，妖邪也会惧怕的吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ebfdf3234820d60a90dd8235d8630e82_1152277774779022852.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"啊…好天气，真是舒服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/97b1ebead53178f473a4f7a0387cfc0c_3947169152274686341.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早晨的好时光可不能辜负，抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a3b330efc47d3c398b36b0ed5aba62df_1176063753255622716.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"正午灵气极盛，可得抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/690c3d71fe134cfc76c34055b4c99a1f_9027989624278325610.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"晚间最适静息凝神，更要抓紧练功。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3452d9d44e9c5109fbf17c239d9b9327_3663440877911693533.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"呼，累了一整天，你也休息去吧。明天再去传闻中鬼怪出没的老宅看看，说好了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0d807d5c6034fd200ca1b0bc25d78d15_3054421642618985225.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云自己·方士","content":"我们方士一派自古守护璃月，传承久远，剿杀邪魔自然是手到擒来。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a60d98b76ff5daaa232495c9db4a21fa_6592190303557441912.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于重云自己·委托","content":"明明什么都没做，只是进了凶宅的门就解决了问题。这个委托的报酬，你觉得是拿还是不拿呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/991f970be12f1a24ee43e07eb13fc8e9_3195477237056975262.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·旅伴","content":"你的本事不错，对丘丘…咳…邪魔从不手软，我们结伴而行如何。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2277abe966c071cd24d84acc9d78caf8_6398704131711695585.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·怪谈","content":"璃月的奇闻异事你已经见了不少吧，你说的那些方外的鬼怪，我…我也想看看。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ae4ed6255d0d23b0eebbc5874eb4e44c_7001383679649733847.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"「神之眼」虽然厉害，却不可盲目依赖。我还是更加信任方术和武技。本事要精进，还是得勤学苦练。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0cddd0137c83fc25364bf2c777d52c8a_5935215979098430987.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"璃月的土地上妖邪传闻虽然众多，但真假掺杂，有些奇奇怪怪的委托…其实跟鬼怪一点关系也没有。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1e0cfb396dd8af9b828aa1f575980c8f_8870577467848909461.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"听说琥牢山的琥珀中封存了不少稀奇古怪的东西，会不会也有一些历史传说中的妖邪呢？真想见识见识。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6c429b6b81dc4e9266816a98cdb3174f_3802140831826656670.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"「往生堂」的钟离先生啊，隐约觉得是个厉害角色，凡夫恶党杀人，我们方士除妖，他居然能葬仙人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3acef5cb45170a63ea051bc0c45ab553_7137975897789699243.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"我虽然敬佩行秋的武艺和侠心。但是我一定要事先提醒你，他坏心思也不少。如果真的发生了什么事情，记得回来和我结成受害者同盟啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/22b63d2125bcbd603143728411289e50_7227497933499358180.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"降魔大圣和我们方士一派，一暗一明，共守璃月，历史已久，我非常尊敬魈上仙。但是，那位大人居然说…居然说什么驱邪方士量小力微不值一提，我，我绝对不能苟同！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d986c10e04357281d5cb9c71fd01895e_8159754561076474866.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"「往生堂」的手段还是信得过的。但是那副「不用你们方士操心」的嘻嘻笑脸却看着让人火大…呼，冷静冷静。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/54e84d7cdf557726e8a09065e8411b01_2932832259245526737.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于七七…","content":"看起来是个僵尸小姑娘，但作为方士我能察觉到…她可不一般。嗯…名字也不见宝诰之中，究竟是哪尊呢…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/749b18c0f2ac405732eeb88e7fc2adf4_3161998690358200791.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"我会尽可能避开辛焱演出的区域。那般热烈的气氛，即使无意融入，也难免受其影响…我是说，会让人不自在。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/836bdfd5c32a986d26519d3750aec7c9_2892707830489093274.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱…","content":"香菱做菜的手艺有口皆碑，但是她那些辛辣烫口的菜品我是绝对不会碰的…没有，没有什么…你看，史莱姆滑蘑菇？这能吃吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2eef1c94a69398eeac8940daebf3a1f5_708998589928151795.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"我曾听家中长辈聊起过她。她家的遭遇…很让人同情。原以为这次能够让分家的远亲重回家中，长辈们听说她还活着也都高兴坏了，说是要备上礼物，择个吉日好好聚聚。却没想到，平日根本见不到她的人影…等等，按辈分来算的话，我、我该不会…要叫她「小姨」吧…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e3d377fa32b6c432a0f0b591da1c6c8b_1775909718491953391.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于夜兰…","content":"我初任方士那会儿，受邀到委托人家中驱邪，离开时，曾撞见过这位女性。她把我的名字记在某个小册子里，或许是想确认我有没有做值得怀疑的事吧。不过就那一次，后来再没遇见过她。

现在想想，大概是因为我平日打坐总是一动不动，谁看着都会觉得无趣吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b59e93ee0ff0c9fee2058badf5540fa7_2069979387362209250.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其一","content":"本事很重要，不然空有热血，只会坏事。对于这点，我深有体会。啊，倒不是我自己的体会，呃…是近年行走璃月，观看人间百态的感悟。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/365aed6ae5e94003d12976b85716961c_7562942015236198770.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其二","content":"我天生是「纯阳之体」，据说千年难遇，所有鬼怪对我退避三舍。唉…这其实一点都不好，哪有见不着鬼怪的驱邪方士。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2c8673aeaba3a839dfcecccf7022488e_8660302267187139685.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其三","content":"「纯阳之体」常常导致热血太盛，没少害我出糗。我不食辛辣高温、出门撑伞、回避激荡的音律，就是为了克制它。唉…什么时候这体质才能不妨碍我呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f0bca5299bcde55226776ac111a63216_3934770869852463924.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其四","content":"坐等妖邪现身是没用的，得主动寻访。我为璃月人镇邪，于人能免去烦愁，于我也能广开视野。如果你遇到邪祟搅扰，我一定也会立刻来帮你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7981a629e3c5a5c488a4cc382b2dd7a8_911181233445082931.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解重云·其五","content":"剿灭天下妖邪是我身为方士的最终目标，将来这个宏愿实现之后，不管是温泉、绝云椒椒还是别的什么…热血刺激的东西，我其实…都可以考虑。唔…不行。这样想想就会有些激动…不好不好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7e8839b1d863f9fc23eca061db63a0d5_3799518486275512116.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重云的爱好…","content":"我？嗯…我最喜欢的还是听说书。茶博士总是能把各种奇闻怪谈讲得惊心动魄。有空不妨一道去听听。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9aeeb53771a7a9827934679ce65c2c29_8406837148823966468.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重云的烦恼…","content":"经我多方打听，费了好大功夫，才找到一处破庙有妖邪出没！于是，我守了四天，却完全不见妖邪的影子。唉…这种事经常发生。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/faaf839b966dfc8e7872b05c931abcb0_7982044469348442413.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"每日修行完毕后，要是能吃上稻妻运来的生鲜还有冷餐就好了，那种冰凉清爽的口感能缓解所有疲劳。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/96bc827ccc391cf897b8288a38998afb_5014231692705082600.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"所有又烫又辣的食物我都不能入口。如果是有绝云椒椒的菜，啊，想想就吓人。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a9123d7533006d4625e6ea3b5aa99cae_7997897816126823569.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"口感凉爽，正合我意！我要多留一些，等到修行完毕后再来享用。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/4f808b55c1cee3edf4975f5d59c19b14_8933080016890124383.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"不好意思啊。明明是你的一片心意，我却只能放凉再吃…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/f28cf0ce89ee4b4c5cf9ff6798c0088c_6073538985186865363.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"糟糕！这味道是…绝云椒椒？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/9343c976248bce2a4c36684b7d41052b_1632414912200549313.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"今天是你的生辰，这朵冰晶结成的小花送你，是我自己雕的。如果遇到妖邪，掷出冰花，我封入的咒术自会生效，助你脱险。啊…还有，生日快乐。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3030b7fe78f8a12d3f35082c81a0f882_7364617537672558170.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"驱邪的术法也常常用到这些材料，没想到还能用于提升自己的灵气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dbcace19dc958f0fe306709031ad5018_7721173077913653937.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"习武与术法一样，都有境界。受你指导，我又有进益了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f21d58f13e0f68155d1a60d82baf926f_7219009634938579136.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"原来习武之道还有这样一种境界，手眼相通，人与剑合…嗯，我悟到了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/06/11/183046623/2347f8cbf6e784a8b8ab712e012c4d02_5467935500941628455.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"领悟了这些武技，「剿灭天下妖邪」的愿望或许就能达成了。你一路相助，我当然铭感在心，今后赴汤蹈火在所不辞。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d5aa83c941f2ef760755c942722ccb48_5608394113710570156.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","co 重云初出茅庐时，璃月港内恰有一桩怪谈流传。

怪谈的源头是一位豪门阔太，她的身份高到与七星都能说上一两句话。

每夜都有怪声搅扰她的睡眠，可是每次她想要靠近声音的源头，那声音就会从反方向传来，她也因此惶惶不可终日。

以其地位与财力，自然能请动无数知名驱邪方士。但他们屡试屡败，最后都只能铩羽而归。而那怪声不仅没有断绝，反而愈演愈烈。

眼见驱邪无望，这位阔太心如死灰。

就在这时，重云踏入了她的宅门。

「前几天阳光太烈，没有出门…听说这里有很顽固的妖邪，请交给我吧。」

在那之后，重云只是在宅子的中央静坐了一会儿。

当夜，一切细声低语全都消失了。

阔太睡了一个久违的好觉，第二天就带了几大箱金银珠宝登门道谢。

但重云依旧是不苟言笑的模样，只例行收了挂牌的几百摩拉，作为报酬。

从那以后，重云声名鹊起，以其「行事风格」得到评价——心若冰清、面如霜寒。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

事实上，重云的行事风格与「冰霜」之类，全然无关。

自出生起就是「纯阳之体」的他，只会为自己易过热的体质，还有过头的「热血」与「冲劲」而困扰。

为了压制这种体质，重云试遍了各种偏方。

不喝热水，不吃热食，不沾辛辣，不衣厚裳，不争执，不起怒，暴晒之日不出门，驱邪时必带伞…

总之就是刻意避免与世间一切的「阳」产生接触。

可即便如此，「纯阳之体」的力量还是没有衰弱。

有些沮丧的他，跟自己的身体较起劲来。当他听说龙脊雪山上妖邪出没，便身着单衣入山。

雪山高寒让他体温骤降，但他觉得光是这样还不够，又在结冰的湖面上凿开一个洞，泡在寒水中等待着妖邪的出现。

在风雪冰湖之中足足等待了半天，重云终于察觉到了不寻常的气息。他认定这番苦守终于有了回报，兴奋地追了上去。

结果从山顶一直追到山腰，他才发现那根本就不是什么妖邪，只是一只被飞剑和浮空桃符吓到了的雪兔。

…在那之后，他发高烧的天数，也比常人要漫长得多。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

「纯阳之体」不仅是重云方士之路上的一大障碍，也是日常生活中的大麻烦。

他对「阳」的存在非常敏感，稍不注意，阳气便会暴走，导致性情大变。

重云的家族曾在「万民堂」举办祝宴，虽然他已经刻意等到菜凉再吃，但他没想到「万民堂」的糯米丸子里，居然还包着「绝云椒椒」。

一口下去，要说发生了什么事…重云自己也记不清了。

但当时的受害者，「万民堂」的掌厨香菱，至今还记得好多经典片段：

重云跳上掌柜长桌，大喊所有客人都由他一人买单，尽管他其实根本没带钱；

他与每一桌的客人攀谈，勾肩搭背地介绍他们家的方术如何厉害，走的时候还不忘记吃上一口别人桌上的菜；

不知怎么，他又说「万民堂」中有妖邪，遍寻不着，倒是给香菱的额头上来了一张符咒，用剑追着她到处跑。

事后为了弥补损失、表达歉意，重云省吃俭用了一个月，才结清了「万民堂」的账，还不得不附赠香菱一块亲手刻制的辟邪桃符。

香菱倒是不在意重云的「冒犯」。在她看来，那场宴会上的重云，才是和大家距离最近的重云。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

漫长的妖邪寻访之路上，重云喜获一名好友——行秋。

与信奉勤学苦练的重云相比，行秋天生聪颖，看问题的方式也更机灵。

听说重云的苦恼之后，行秋想到一个解决办法。

「如果不是让纯阳之体失效，而是找到不会被纯阳之体吓跑的妖邪呢？ 」这句话点醒了重云。自此，重云每天不再费心削弱「纯阳之体」，转而邀请行秋一道探访不会被吓跑的妖邪。

「什么？你说在云来海附近看到了传说中的傲因？好的，交给我吧！ 」

「绯云坡的那间老宅，居然已经被恶鬼占据了吗？是我疏忽了，我现在就去。」

「望舒客栈来了个驱邪高人？跟着他就能找到凶恶的妖邪了吧，那…不能空手去拜访，要准备点什么东西才行。」

这些情报大多是行秋信口胡诌的。托他的福，重云往往败兴而归，苦着脸抱怨自己时运不济。

「我尽力去找了，还重金购买妖邪情报！结果却是白跑一趟。」重云委屈地说。如果此时行秋闲着，便会笑容满面地劝重云打起精神，带他去吃新发现的冰凉小食，再帮他讨回被骗的钱。

多么可靠又热心的朋友啊！重云感激地想。行秋真好，除了行秋，他还能相信谁呢？

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

重云也希望自己能更合群些。可为了把控「纯阳之体」，他总是被迫拒绝各路邀请。

其中，他最难理解的行为，叫作「泡温泉」。

一池热气蒸腾的浑水，居然要泡在那个里面——这可比龙脊雪山的冰湖还要恐怖一百倍。

但他发现，每个人聊到温泉都是一脸向往，更有人声称水越烫越舒服，泡完温泉一整周都能活力无限。

重云不明白，这究竟是真话，还是在刻意捉弄他。

说不想尝试绝对是骗人的，可「纯阳之体」一日不消，他便一日不敢踏入温泉。

某天，行秋问他：

「如果有朝一日，你驾驭了纯阳之体，又斩尽天下妖邪，在那之后…你会去干什么呢？」

看似无心的一句话，让重云再次陷入困扰——

由于体质特殊，他错失了许多应有的人生体验。

可他并不觉得遗憾。山重水复，柳暗花明，他已找到属于自己的答案。

若那一天真的到来，就去泡温泉吧。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

重云家世代传承的奇书，记载了所有被降伏的妖邪。

从无名小妖，到活跃在奇谈志异中的大鬼，种类万千，令人眼花缭乱。

重云正是受到书中一段段惊人逸闻的激励，才立下杀尽天下妖邪的志向。

但对他来说，继承这本书录…也带来了一丝小小的不便。

书中记载妖邪，除了文字记述，还配有绘图。历任传承者画技不一，却也尽心描摹出了妖邪的大体特征。

可重云驱邪，向来见不到妖邪形貌。又不能因此坏了插图配文的规矩，为此绞尽脑汁。

走投无路的重云只能根据想象，自由编绘一些奇奇怪怪的插图。

——由此，《妖邪奇志家录》变得越发清奇。要是看到七只鸡翅五条鸡腿的凶兽，或是半鱼半丘丘人模样的妖孽，最好不要过分深究。

「我看其他方士又是舞剑又是贴符的，你在这儿坐了一会儿就说事毕，还想让我付钱？糊弄谁呢！」

初任方士时，重云屡受质疑。

一大难题就此压在他头上：比起屋里「有妖邪」，「没有妖邪」难证明得多。

与任何一位舞剑驭符的方士相比，他都更像是一个江湖骗子。

空有一身本领却无处施展，被迫忍受委托人的质疑，由于害怕阳气暴走，还要努力压制热血辩驳的冲动…

到最后，来向他道歉的人也没有几个。可就算如此，重云也不愿随波逐流，用装模作样的法事掩盖真正的驱邪方式。哪怕受到体质干扰，重云也从未有过放弃的念头。

总有一天，他会成为璃月首屈一指的驱邪师，还要驾驭住这纯阳之体，让全天下妖邪消失殆尽。

或许是这份惊人的斗志受到了神的肯定——重云得到的「神之眼」，竟是与「火」相对的「冰」。

至于这「神之眼」是回应他哪个想法而降临，就不得而知了。

关于重云…

辛焱

他超有意思！看上去文静内向，但有一次演出，他好像是被朋友叫过来，要跟我说什么话。舞台上声音太大，我还没听清呢，他已经一个箭步跳上台来和我一起唱了，还唱得特别摇滚。这就叫「人不可貌相」吧。

香菱

重云啊，他总是跟着行秋一起来「万民堂」吃饭…呃，或者应该说，是被行秋拖来的？但是重云不吃热食。每次热菜上桌，行秋就会客客气气地说一声「失敬」，然后动起筷子逐一评点起每道菜的美味之处，他那夸得呀，我都想冲过去尝一口！你是没见到重云那种眼神，哈哈哈。还挺有趣的呢，他俩。

行秋

唉，重云这家伙，虽然也知道我的底细，但真要和他搭档去完成任务还得审慎。他现在还是执着「武」技，却不理解「侠」心的境界。需要多练练。尤其…是吃辣的方面，哈哈。

胡桃

纯阳正气，阴阳合一？啧啧，嘶…没想到世上真有这种体质的人。

申鹤

真没想到我在这世上…还有「亲缘」。他若是有什么修行上的困惑，我愿帮忙解答。不过，得请他上山来。他们一家太过热情，我不知道该如何回绝才符合礼数…

嘉明

听说那位仁兄有「纯阳之体」，按照我们那边的说法，他体内可能虚火很旺啊，应该多喝点凉茶喔他。

蓝砚

有一次我跟着爷爷上门占卦，正巧碰到他从事主家中沮丧离开…我本以为屋里头的情况不容乐观，就连他也无计可施了。可我进屋后并没有感受到任何不妙的气息，爷爷这边得出的也是吉卦…兴许是他费了大功夫，累到没力气说话了。你说他很可能什么都没做？那我就更不懂了…

主题：偶有所思…

发件人：重云

时间：2026-09-07

又是一年生辰。不知是不是如同行秋所说：「年长方知愁滋味」，今早吃完了用来庆贺生辰的糕点后，我反而有些茫然。

我年岁渐长，想来也是时候担起责任，但再一想，我连自己的「纯阳之体」都没摸出个头绪来，奇术的修炼进度也不理想，一念至此，还真是有点发愁。行秋却和我说会发愁是好事，愁中有真义，还有莫畏浮云遮望眼什么的…但无论如何，我还是想要先把这「纯阳之体」给弄明白…

我记得蓝砚蓝师傅家中有一门奇术，可以帮人卜算吉凶，有机会的话。或许我真该请她给我卜一卦…

哦对了！这些糕点你也尝尝，特别好吃，呃…凉了也好吃，真的。

主题：新岁之誓…

发件人：重云

时间：2025-09-07

又添一岁，本该更进一竿才是。然而近来四方清平，竟无妖邪可诛。数番寻访皆空手而归…我绝非期盼妖魔作乱！只是这般日复一日苦修，若久不经实战砥砺…哎！

一念及此，心底的不甘便如野火燎原，灼得人坐卧难安。情急之下——我也不过是多吃了些冰棍罢了！行秋却打趣说我好歹练就了制冰好手艺。

哼，他既这般说，我便索性多制了些！诸般口味，俱有尝试。若你不嫌弃，还请来尝尝？

此番坦言请莫要见笑。

新岁之誓不可废，自当继续挥剑、不断找寻！如此，才不负这手中长剑…和那些下肚的冰棍！

主题：应验！

发件人：重云

时间：2024-09-07

又是一年生辰。莫非是往年许了「早日看见妖邪」的愿望，在昨夜梦中应验了？我一睁眼便即刻描摹梦中所见，可惜边画边忘，最终成像只得「长尾」、「鳍背」些许特征…

我拿着图画多方探听消息，方从行秋口中得知此类妖邪源于纳塔，须在温泉或岩浆中方可将其彻底剿灭，着实扎手…

听闻珍友你正在纳塔游历，如若遭遇此等妖邪，还请你留下画片，他日与我详叙。

届时一场鏖战想必在所难免，特为你送些家乡吃食，提振士气！

主题：斩妖诛邪！

发件人：重云

时间：2023-09-07

近日妖邪出没，着实猖狂。虽然今日是我的生辰，但作为天衡方士，岂能整日安乐，放任妖邪作乱？

自当动身斩妖诛邪，护得一方安宁！

我深知你向来以行侠仗义闻名璃月，想必也不能错过这个机会吧？不如前来一聚，酣战一番，痛斩妖孽…

咳咳…

方才所言，多有失态…不过想要邀请你前来一聚，却是出自本心。快意之时友人远隔干里，不免遗憾。

你大可不必担心餐食的口味，我最近重金购得一味解辣良方，效果立竿见影。

主题：家里人说…

发件人：重云

时间：2022-09-07

按照家里人的说法，每年生辰都是我们天衡方士的大日子，需要用心对待。

今年生辰，我得跟着几位长辈上山祈禳。我都计划好了，要祈求流年顺遂、修行有成、出门能看见妖邪、吃饭时厨子别放绝云椒椒…

还有，望你能出入平安。

不能只有我一个人万事胜意，珍视的朋友也得顺顺利利。

对了，不知道你今日有没有时间？我可以请你来天衡山跟我们一道禳灾祈福吗？

主题：今日…

发件人：重云

时间：2021-09-07

今日若有闲暇，还请与我见上一面。

请见谅，我实在不知该如何表达自己的心情，想了整整一天…想得脸都发热了，仍是没能找到更怡当的措辞。可若不趁此机会告诉你，接下来的一年我都会后悔。

无须担心！这回不同以往，不是要结伴练功，也不是去寻访妖邪。仅仅是想同你小聚一番，随性地聊聊。

想请你听我说说近来的奇闻异事，也想听你谈谈旅途中的所见所感。

此外，我…自觉武艺小有精进，还想请你指点一二。

冰棍我已经备足了！无论发生怎样的特殊情况，都不会破坏这次聚会。我会等你来。
